svg.title: Open UI Scout before and after comparison
svg.desc: The left side shows AI hand-rolling UI from memory. The right side shows Open UI Scout inspecting the project, scouting GitHub UI references, scoring candidates, and recombining UI for the current project.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif
